Cfg.Page.Title: 酒馆配置
Tavern config
Cfg.Page.Subtitle: 调整端口、访问范围与启动行为，修改在下次启动服务时生效。
Tune the port, reachability, and launch behavior. Changes apply the next time the service starts.
Cfg.DirtyHint.Saved: 已保存 · {0}，下次启动服务时生效
Saved at {0}; applies on the next service start
Cfg.Action.Reset.Name: 恢复默认配置
Restore the default config
Cfg.Version.Simple.Title: 小白版 · 常用设置
Simple · common settings
Cfg.Version.Advanced.Title: 高手版 · 全部选项
Advanced · every option
Cfg.Version.Simple.Hint: 只放最常用的几项，其余按官方推荐值跑就好。
Only the essentials; everything else runs on the official defaults.
Cfg.Version.Advanced.Hint: 官方 config.yaml 的全部选项，逐项标注对应字段。
Every option in the official config.yaml, each labelled with its field.
Cfg.Simple.Section.Title: 常用设置
Common settings
Cfg.Simple.Section.Hint: 改完自动保存，下次启动酒馆时生效。
Saved as you change it; applies the next time the tavern starts.
Cfg.Simple.Port.Title: 端口
Port
Cfg.Simple.Port.Hint: 手机、平板访问酒馆时用的门牌号，一般不用改。
The address phones and tablets use to reach the tavern; usually you can leave it alone.
Cfg.Simple.Lan.Title: 局域网访问
LAN access
Cfg.Simple.Lan.Hint: 打开后，同一个 Wi-Fi 下的手机、平板也能打开酒馆。
Lets phones and tablets on the same Wi-Fi open the tavern.
Cfg.Simple.AutoOpen.Title: 自动打开浏览器
Open the browser automatically
Cfg.Simple.AutoOpen.Hint: 启动后自动帮你打开酒馆页面，不用手动点。
Opens the tavern page for you after start, no manual click needed.
Cfg.Simple.Browser.Title: 默认浏览器
Default browser
Cfg.Simple.Browser.Hint: 自动打开时用哪个浏览器；和首页的快捷切换是同一个设置。
Which browser opens it; the same setting as the quick switch on the dashboard.
Cfg.Simple.Whitelist.Title: IP 白名单
IP whitelist
Cfg.Simple.Whitelist.Hint: 只有名单里的地址能连上酒馆；127.0.0.1 与 ::1 固定保留。
Only listed addresses can reach the tavern; 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are always kept.
Cfg.Whitelist.Add.Name: 新增白名单地址
New whitelist address
Cfg.Whitelist.Add.Placeholder: 输入 IP 或网段，回车即可添加
Type an IP or subnet and press Enter
Cfg.Whitelist.Note.Editable: 只有名单里的地址能连上酒馆；127.0.0.1 与 ::1 固定保留，其余可以增删。
Only listed addresses can reach the tavern; 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are always kept, the rest can be added or removed.
Cfg.Whitelist.Note.Desktop: 桌面模式只允许本机通过内置窗口访问，名单固定为 127.0.0.1 与 ::1，无需修改。
Desktop mode only allows local access through the built-in window; the list is fixed to 127.0.0.1 and ::1 and needs no edits.
Cfg.Whitelist.Note.Scope: 名单按「{0}」自动生成，不可手动修改。
The list is generated from "{0}" and cannot be edited here.
Cfg.Whitelist.Hint.Desktop: 桌面模式由启动器的内置窗口打开酒馆，只有本机能访问。
Desktop mode opens the tavern in the launcher's built-in window, so only this machine can reach it.
Cfg.Whitelist.Hint.Server: 服务器模式下按「服务范围」自动生成：局域网放行本机网段，互联网全开放。
In server mode the list follows the service scope: LAN allows your subnet, Internet allows everything.
Cfg.Whitelist.Adv.Desktop: 桌面模式只允许本机访问，白名单固定为 127.0.0.1 与 ::1。对应 whitelistMode。
Desktop mode allows local access only; the whitelist is fixed to 127.0.0.1 and ::1. Maps to whitelistMode.
Cfg.Whitelist.Adv.Scope: 开启后只有名单内的地址能连接。名单按「服务范围」自动生成，对应 whitelistMode。
When on, only listed addresses can connect. The list follows the service scope. Maps to whitelistMode.
Cfg.Whitelist.Adv.On: 开启后只有名单内的地址能连接；127.0.0.1 与 ::1 固定保留。对应 whitelistMode。
When on, only listed addresses can connect; 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are always kept. Maps to whitelistMode.
Cfg.Remove.Name: 移除该项
Remove this entry
Cfg.Port.Range: The port must be between 1024 and 65535
Cfg.G1.Title: 网络与访问
Network and access
Cfg.G1.Hint: 端口、监听地址、协议栈与默认浏览器
Port, listen addresses, protocol stack, and default browser
Cfg.G1.Hint.Client: 端口、监听地址与协议栈
Port, listen addresses, and protocol stack
Cfg.G1.Port.Title: 端口
Port
Cfg.G1.Port.Hint: 服务监听端口。对应 port，可用范围 1024–65535。
The port the service listens on. Maps to port; valid range 1024–65535.
Cfg.G1.Listen.Title: 监听地址
Listen addresses
Cfg.G1.Listen.Hint: 监听的具体地址，支持 IPv4 与 IPv6。对应 listenAddress.ipv4 与 listenAddress.ipv6，默认监听所有网卡。
The exact addresses to bind, IPv4 and IPv6. Maps to listenAddress.ipv4 and listenAddress.ipv6; by default all interfaces.
Cfg.G1.V4.Name: IPv4 监听地址
IPv4 listen address
Cfg.G1.V6.Name: IPv6 监听地址
IPv6 listen address
Cfg.G1.Proto4.Tip: 至少要启用一个协议：IPv4 / IPv6。对应 protocol.ipv4。
At least one protocol must stay on: IPv4 / IPv6. Maps to protocol.ipv4.
Cfg.G1.Proto6.Tip: 至少要启用一个协议；auto 会按系统是否支持自动检测。对应 protocol.ipv6。
At least one protocol must stay on; auto detects whether the system supports it. Maps to protocol.ipv6.
Cfg.G1.DnsPreferV6.Tip: 解析域名时优先用 IPv6；运营商 IPv6 有问题时别开。对应 dnsPreferIPv6。
Prefers IPv6 when resolving domains; leave it off if your ISP's IPv6 is unreliable. Maps to dnsPreferIPv6.
Cfg.G1.Heartbeat.Title: 心跳间隔
Heartbeat interval
Cfg.G1.Heartbeat.Hint: 秒；写心跳文件的间隔，0 表示关闭。对应 heartbeatInterval。
Seconds between heartbeat file writes; 0 turns it off. Maps to heartbeatInterval.
Cfg.G1.AutoOpen.Title: 自动打开浏览器
Open the browser automatically
Cfg.G1.AutoOpen.Hint: 酒馆启动时自动打开浏览器。对应 browserLaunch.enabled。
Opens the browser when the tavern starts. Maps to browserLaunch.enabled.
Cfg.G1.Browser.Title: 默认浏览器
Default browser
Cfg.G1.Browser.Hint: 用哪个浏览器打开。对应 browserLaunch.browser：default / firefox / chrome / edge，Android 不支持。
Which browser to use. Maps to browserLaunch.browser: default / firefox / chrome / edge; not supported on Android.
Cfg.G2.Title: 账号与访问控制
Accounts and access control
Cfg.G2.Hint: 基础认证、用户账号、白名单与 Host 校验
Basic auth, user accounts, whitelists, and Host checks
Cfg.G2.BasicAuth.Title: 基础认证
Basic auth
Cfg.G2.BasicAuth.Hint: 为接口开启基础认证，打开酒馆时要输用户名和密码。对应 basicAuthMode。
Turns on basic auth for the API; opening the tavern then asks for a username and password. Maps to basicAuthMode.
Cfg.G2.User.Title: 用户名
Username
Cfg.G2.User.Name: 认证用户名
Auth username
Cfg.G2.Pass.Title: 密码
Password
Cfg.G2.Pass.Name: 认证密码
Auth password
Cfg.G2.UserAccounts.Tip: 多用户模式，每人各自登录。对应 enableUserAccounts。
Multi-user mode; everyone signs in separately. Maps to enableUserAccounts.
Cfg.G2.DiscreetLogin.Tip: 登录页不显示用户列表，只能手动输用户名。对应 enableDiscreetLogin。
The sign-in page hides the user list; the name must be typed. Maps to enableDiscreetLogin.
Cfg.G2.PerUserAuth.Tip: 与基础认证同时开启时，认证用的用户名密码与各自账号一致。对应 perUserBasicAuth。
With basic auth on, the credentials match each user's own account. Maps to perUserBasicAuth.
Cfg.G2.Whitelist.Title: IP 白名单
IP whitelist
Cfg.G2.Whitelist.Hint: 开启后只有名单内的地址能连接，对应 whitelistMode。
When on, only listed addresses can connect. Maps to whitelistMode.
Cfg.G2.Host.Title: Host 白名单
Host whitelist
Cfg.G2.Host.Hint: 校验请求头里的 Host，防止域名伪装；建议在开启监听（局域网访问）时使用。对应 hostWhitelist.enabled。
Validates the Host header to block domain spoofing; recommended whenever the service listens on the network. Maps to hostWhitelist.enabled.
Cfg.G2.HostScan: 扫描 Host 头自动补充
Scan Host headers to fill in
Cfg.G2.HostScan.Tip: 扫描收到的请求，识别疑似 Host 头伪装。对应 hostWhitelist.scan。
Scans incoming requests for suspected Host header spoofing. Maps to hostWhitelist.scan.
Cfg.G2.HostList.Name: Host 白名单列表
Host whitelist entries
Cfg.G2.ImportDomains.Title: 导入域名
Import domains
Cfg.G2.ImportDomains.Hint: 从这些域名导入角色卡时，信任它们提供的图片地址。对应 whitelistImportDomains。
Images from these domains are trusted when importing character cards. Maps to whitelistImportDomains.
Cfg.G2.ImportDomains.Name: 导入域名列表
Import domain list
Cfg.G2.ImportDomains.Placeholder: 每行一个域名，例如 example.com
One domain per line, e.g. example.com
Cfg.G3.Title: HTTPS / SSL
HTTPS / SSL
Cfg.G3.Hint: 启用加密传输，配置证书与私钥路径
Turn on encrypted transport and point at the certificate and key
Cfg.G3.Enabled.Title: 启用 HTTPS
Enable HTTPS
Cfg.G3.Enabled.Hint: 启用 SSL/TLS 加密；必须同时提供证书与私钥，否则服务起不来。对应 ssl.enabled。
Turns on SSL/TLS; both the certificate and the key are required or the service will not start. Maps to ssl.enabled.
Cfg.G3.Cert.Title: 证书路径
Certificate path
Cfg.G3.Key.Title: 私钥路径
Private key path
Cfg.G3.Pass.Title: 私钥口令
Key passphrase
Cfg.G3.Pass.Hint: 私钥口令，私钥没有加密就留空。对应 ssl.keyPassphrase；更安全的做法是用命令行参数或环境变量传入。
Passphrase for the key; leave empty when the key is not encrypted. Maps to ssl.keyPassphrase; passing it via a command-line argument or environment variable is safer.
Cfg.G4.Title: 跨域 CORS
CORS
Cfg.G4.Hint: 允许来源、方法与请求头，按需收紧
Allowed origins, methods, and headers — tighten as needed
Cfg.G4.Enabled.Title: 启用 CORS
Enable CORS
Cfg.G4.Enabled.Hint: 启用或关闭 CORS 中间件；关掉后跨域请求会被浏览器直接拦下。对应 cors.enabled。
Turns the CORS middleware on or off; when off the browser blocks cross-origin requests outright. Maps to cors.enabled.
Cfg.G4.Origin.Title: 允许来源
Allowed origins
Cfg.G4.Origin.Hint: 允许的来源：null 表示浏览器直接打开本地文件，* 表示允许任意来源。对应 cors.origin，每行一个。
Allowed origins: null means pages opened from local files, * means any origin. Maps to cors.origin; one per line.
Cfg.G4.Origin.Name: CORS 允许来源
CORS allowed origins
Cfg.G4.Methods.Title: 允许方法
Allowed methods
Cfg.G4.Methods.Hint: 允许的 HTTP 方法。对应 cors.methods，每行一个。
Allowed HTTP methods. Maps to cors.methods; one per line.
Cfg.G4.Methods.Name: CORS 允许方法
CORS allowed methods
Cfg.G4.MaxAge.Title: 预检缓存时间
Preflight cache
Cfg.G4.MaxAge.Hint: 预检请求的缓存时间（秒），留空表示不发送缓存头。对应 cors.maxAge。
How long (seconds) preflight results are cached; empty sends no cache header. Maps to cors.maxAge.
Cfg.G4.AllowHeaders.Title: 允许请求头
Allowed headers
Cfg.G4.AllowHeaders.Name: CORS 允许请求头
CORS allowed headers
Cfg.G4.AllowHeaders.Placeholder: 每行一个，留空表示不限制
One per line; empty means no limit
Cfg.G4.ExposeHeaders.Title: 暴露响应头
Exposed headers
Cfg.G4.ExposeHeaders.Name: CORS 暴露响应头
CORS exposed headers
Cfg.G4.Credentials.Tip: 允许携带 Cookie 与 Authorization 头；开启后来源不能用 *。对应 cors.credentials。
Allows cookies and the Authorization header; origins can no longer be *. Maps to cors.credentials.
Cfg.G5.Title: 代理与备份
Proxy and backups
Cfg.G5.Hint: 请求代理、备份份数与聊天记录保护
Request proxy, backup counts, and chat protection
Cfg.G5.Proxy.Title: 请求代理
Request proxy
Cfg.G5.Proxy.Hint: 开启后，所有出站的 HTTP/HTTPS 请求都走这个代理。对应 requestProxy.enabled。
When on, every outgoing HTTP/HTTPS request goes through this proxy. Maps to requestProxy.enabled.
Cfg.G5.ProxyUrl.Title: 代理地址
Proxy URL
Cfg.G5.ProxyBypass.Title: 直连主机
Direct hosts
Cfg.G5.ProxyBypass.Name: 代理直连主机
Proxy bypass hosts
Cfg.G5.ProxyBypass.Placeholder: 每行一个，这些地址不走代理
One per line; these addresses bypass the proxy
Cfg.G5.Backups.Title: 通用备份份数
Backup copies
Cfg.G5.Backups.Hint: 每个聊天文件与设置文件各保留多少份备份。对应 backups.common.numberOfBackups。
How many backup copies to keep for each chat and settings file. Maps to backups.common.numberOfBackups.
Cfg.G5.ChatBackup.Title: 聊天记录备份
Chat backups
Cfg.G5.ChatBackup.Hint: 自动备份聊天记录，避免误删。对应 backups.chat.enabled。
Backs up chats automatically so nothing is lost by accident. Maps to backups.chat.enabled.
Cfg.G5.Integrity.Tip: 保存前先校验聊天文件完整，避免写入坏数据。对应 backups.chat.checkIntegrity。
Checks the chat file before saving so corrupt data never lands. Maps to backups.chat.checkIntegrity.
Cfg.G5.MaxBackups.Title: 最大备份数
Max backups
Cfg.G5.MaxBackups.Hint: 每个用户最多保留多少份聊天备份（从最新的算起），-1 表示全部保留。对应 backups.chat.maxTotalBackups。
How many chat backups to keep per user, counting from the newest; -1 keeps them all. Maps to backups.chat.maxTotalBackups.
Cfg.G5.MaxBackups.Name: 完整备份上限
Backup limit
Cfg.G5.Throttle.Title: 写入节流间隔
Write throttle
Cfg.G5.Throttle.Hint: 毫秒；同一用户两次聊天备份之间的最小间隔。对应 backups.chat.throttleInterval。
Milliseconds; the minimum gap between two chat backups for the same user. Maps to backups.chat.throttleInterval.
Cfg.G6.Title: 缩略图
Thumbnails
Cfg.G6.Hint: 格式、质量与各类图片的生成尺寸
Format, quality, and generated sizes for each image kind
Cfg.G6.Enabled.Title: 启用缩略图
Enable thumbnails
Cfg.G6.Enabled.Hint: 是否生成角色头像缩略图；关掉后角色列表加载原图，流量更大也更清晰。对应 thumbnails.enabled。
Whether to generate character avatar thumbnails; turning it off loads originals — heavier but sharper. Maps to thumbnails.enabled.
Cfg.G6.Format.Title: 图片格式
Image format
Cfg.G6.Format.Hint: 头像缩略图格式：jpg 压缩最好但不能透明，png 保留透明但体积大约翻倍。对应 thumbnails.format，只影响新缩略图。
Avatar thumbnail format: jpg compresses best but has no transparency, png keeps it at roughly double the size. Maps to thumbnails.format; only affects new thumbnails.
Cfg.G6.Format.Name: 缩略图格式
Thumbnail format
Cfg.G6.Quality.Title: 压缩质量
JPEG quality
Cfg.G6.Quality.Hint: JPG 缩略图质量，1–100，越高越清晰也越大。对应 thumbnails.quality。
JPEG thumbnail quality, 1–100; higher is sharper and larger. Maps to thumbnails.quality.
Cfg.G6.Quality.Name: 缩略图质量
Thumbnail quality
Cfg.G6.BgSize.Title: 背景缩略图尺寸
Background thumbnail size
Cfg.G6.BgSize.Hint: 宽 × 高，像素。对应 thumbnails.dimensions。
Width × height in pixels. Maps to thumbnails.dimensions.
Cfg.G6.BgW.Name: 背景缩略图宽
Background thumbnail width
Cfg.G6.BgH.Name: 背景缩略图高
Background thumbnail height
Cfg.G6.AvatarSize.Title: 头像缩略图尺寸
Avatar thumbnail size
Cfg.G6.AvatarSize.Hint: 宽 × 高，像素。对应 thumbnails.dimensions。
Width × height in pixels. Maps to thumbnails.dimensions.
Cfg.G6.AvatarW.Name: 头像缩略图宽
Avatar thumbnail width
Cfg.G6.AvatarH.Name: 头像缩略图高
Avatar thumbnail height
Cfg.G6.CardSize.Title: 角色卡缩略图尺寸
Character thumbnail size
Cfg.G6.CardSize.Hint: 宽 × 高，像素。对应 thumbnails.dimensions。
Width × height in pixels. Maps to thumbnails.dimensions.
Cfg.G6.CardW.Name: 角色卡缩略图宽
Character card thumbnail width
Cfg.G6.CardH.Name: 角色卡缩略图高
Character card thumbnail height
Cfg.G7.Title: 性能
Performance
Cfg.G7.Hint: 加载策略与缓存，低配机器可优先调这里
Loading strategy and cache — the first place to tune on a low-end machine
Cfg.G7.LazyLoad.Tip: 进角色列表后才加载详情，卡片很多时首屏更快；可能和个别扩展不兼容。对应 performance.lazyLoadCharacters。
Loads details only when the character list opens, which speeds up the first screen with many cards; may conflict with a few extensions. Maps to performance.lazyLoadCharacters.
Cfg.G7.DiskCache.Tip: 把角色卡缓存到磁盘，卡片很多时加载更快。对应 performance.useDiskCache。
Caches character cards on disk for faster loading with many cards. Maps to performance.useDiskCache.
Cfg.G7.MemoryCache.Title: 内存缓存容量
Memory cache size
Cfg.G7.MemoryCache.Hint: 解析后的角色卡最多能占多少内存，0 表示关闭内存缓存。对应 performance.memoryCacheCapacity。
How much memory parsed character cards may occupy; 0 turns the memory cache off. Maps to performance.memoryCacheCapacity.
Cfg.G8.Title: 日志
Logging
Cfg.G8.Hint: 访问日志与最低输出级别
Access log and minimum output level
Cfg.G8.AccessLog.Tip: 把每次访问写进 access.log 并输出到控制台。对应 logging.enableAccessLog。
Writes every request to access.log and the console. Maps to logging.enableAccessLog.
Cfg.G8.MinLevel.Title: 最低日志级别
Minimum log level
Cfg.G8.MinLevel.Hint: 终端里显示的最低日志级别：DEBUG = 0、INFO = 1、WARN = 2、ERROR = 3。对应 logging.minLogLevel。
The lowest level shown in the terminal: DEBUG = 0, INFO = 1, WARN = 2, ERROR = 3. Maps to logging.minLogLevel.
Cfg.G9.Title: 会话与安全
Session and security
Cfg.G9.Hint: 会话行为、扩展与若干高风险开关
Session behavior, extensions, and a few high-risk switches
Cfg.G9.Placeholder.Title: 输入框占位文案
Prompt placeholder
Cfg.G9.Placeholder.Hint: 新对话输入框里的占位提示文字。对应 promptPlaceholder。
Placeholder text shown in the new-chat input box. Maps to promptPlaceholder.
Cfg.G9.SessionTimeout.Title: 会话超时
Session timeout
Cfg.G9.SessionTimeout.Hint: 用户会话超时（秒）：正数 = 闲置多久后登出；0 = 关闭浏览器即失效；负数 = 永不登出。对应 sessionTimeout。
Session timeout in seconds: positive signs out after that much idle time, 0 ends it when the browser closes, negative never signs out. Maps to sessionTimeout.
Cfg.G9.Extensions.Tip: 启用界面扩展。对应 extensions.enabled。
Turns on UI extensions. Maps to extensions.enabled.
Cfg.G9.ExtAutoUpdate.Tip: 扩展发布新版本时自动更新。对应 extensions.autoUpdate。
Updates extensions automatically when a new version ships. Maps to extensions.autoUpdate.
Cfg.G9.ServerPlugins.Tip: 启用服务器插件。对应 enableServerPlugins。
Turns on server plugins. Maps to enableServerPlugins.
Cfg.G9.ServerPluginsAuto.Tip: 启动时自动更新服务器插件。对应 enableServerPluginsAutoUpdate。
Updates server plugins at startup. Maps to enableServerPluginsAutoUpdate.
Cfg.G9.Authelia.Tip: 在反向代理上装好 Authelia 后再开：用同名账号（小写）自动登录。对应 sso.autheliaAuth。
Turn on only after Authelia runs on your reverse proxy: signs in with the matching lowercase account. Maps to sso.autheliaAuth.
Cfg.G9.Authentik.Tip: 在反向代理上装好 Authentik 后再开：用同名账号（小写）自动登录。对应 sso.authentikAuth。
Turn on only after Authentik runs on your reverse proxy: signs in with the matching lowercase account. Maps to sso.authentikAuth.
Cfg.G9.CacheBuster.Tip: 首次加载或上传图片后清除浏览器缓存；需要 localhost 或 HTTPS 域名才生效。对应 cacheBuster.enabled。
Clears the browser cache after the first load or an image upload; only works on localhost or an HTTPS domain. Maps to cacheBuster.enabled.
Cfg.G9.CorsProxy.Tip: 启用 CORS 代理中间件。对应 enableCorsProxy。
Turns on the CORS proxy middleware. Maps to enableCorsProxy.
Cfg.G9.Tokenizers.Tip: 按需下载额外的模型分词器；关闭时回退到本机已有的分词器。对应 enableDownloadableTokenizers。
Downloads extra model tokenizers on demand; when off it falls back to the ones already installed. Maps to enableDownloadableTokenizers.
Cfg.G9.DisableCsrf.Tip: 关闭 CSRF 防护，官方标注「不推荐」。对应 disableCsrfProtection。
Turns CSRF protection off; the official docs mark this as not recommended. Maps to disableCsrfProtection.
Cfg.G9.SkipContentCheck.Tip: 跳过新默认内容的检查。对应 skipContentCheck。
Skips the check for new default content. Maps to skipContentCheck.
Cfg.G9.AllowKeyExport.Tip: 允许通过 API 导出密钥。对应 allowKeysExposure。
Allows keys to be exported through the API. Maps to allowKeysExposure.
Cfg.G9.SecurityOverride.Tip: 关闭启动时的安全检查，官方标注「不推荐」。对应 securityOverride。
Skips the startup safety check; the official docs mark this as not recommended. Maps to securityOverride.
Cfg.G9.CacheBusterRule.Title: 缓存破坏规则
Cache buster rule
Cfg.G9.CacheBusterRule.Hint: 只对匹配该正则的浏览器 UA 清缓存，例如 firefox|safari（不区分大小写）。对应 cacheBuster.userAgentPattern。
